wide_camera.what: the forward wide camera: 8-bit grey frames (flights/<flight>/frames/f_NNNN.png)
wide_camera.model: one-coefficient wide-angle (field of view) model: x_u = X / Z, y_u = Y / Z, r_u = sqrt(x_u^2 + y_u^2), r_d = atan(2 r_u tan(w / 2)) / w, u = fx x_u r_d / r_u + cx, v = fy y_u r_d / r_u + cy
wide_camera.pixel_and_axis_convention: camera +z forward, +x image right, +y image down; integer pixel coordinates at pixel centres: (0, 0) is the centre of the top-left pixel

mounting.meaning: the camera centre in the body frame, and the rotation that turns camera vectors into body vectors (camera +z, the optical axis, is body +x, forward)

time.measured_relation: the exposure of a wide frame lies this long before its recorded stamp (t_s of frames.csv), measured by the maintainers against the depth camera's stamps of the same records

depth_camera.what: the forward depth camera beside the wide camera: its record is withheld; the grader casts its rays into your twin (wide_to_depth.json places it)
depth_camera.ray_table: sensors/depth_rays.npy: one unit ray per pixel in the depth camera frame, array of rows x columns x 3, float64; pixels that never return are NaN

mounting.meaning: the inertial unit in the body frame, as the maker's file gives it

inertial_unit.samples: imu.csv holds the samples in the unit's own axes, as recorded
